# Deep Sky Guide VR - Explore Sky Together

Deep Sky Guide VR is a multi-headset astronomy guidance app for Meta Quest. It is designed for stargazing events, education, families, and group observation.

One Quest headset works as the Guide, while other headsets join as Participants on the same Wi-Fi. The Guide can share sky direction and display states with the Participants, allowing everyone to follow the same part of the sky together.
